question: The Pharmacy (Amendment) Bill, 2023 was passed in Lok Sabha in August, 2023. It amends the Pharmacy Act, _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **original Pharmacy Act was enacted in 1948** to regulate the profession of pharmacy in India.
 
• The Act aims to ensure that** only qualified individuals practice **pharmacy, thereby safeguarding public health.
